### `altText`

```typescript
altText?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Alternate text description for accessibility. Populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element when the document opts into PDF/UA-1.

### `backgroundColor`

```typescript
backgroundColor?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Quiet-zone colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection?: ContentDirectionInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.

### `data`

```typescript
data?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

The data/text to encode. Any Unicode string is accepted.

### `drawBackground`

```typescript
drawBackground?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether to draw the background. If `false`, the symbol is transparent.

### `foregroundColor`

```typescript
foregroundColor?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Module colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `gs1`

```typescript
gs1?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Encode the GS1 start and field separators.

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

When `true`, the symbol is tagged as a decorative `/Artifact`.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `quietZone`

```typescript
quietZone?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Number of quiet-zone modules around the symbol. The spec requires at least 1. Default 2.

### `rectangular`

```typescript
rectangular?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Request a rectangular symbol for short messages where one is available. Defaults to `false` (square symbols).

### `size`

```typescript
size?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Symbol size. Accepts a length: `100`, `'3cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
